ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RM-5,
Residential Multi-Unit Districts and indications as shown on Map No. 7-I in the area
bound by:

      a line 250 feet north of and parallel to West Fullerton Avenue; the alley next east of and
      parallel to North Kedzie Boulevard; a line 100 feet north of and parallel to West Fullerton
      Avenue; and North Kedzie Boulevard,

to those of a RT-3.5, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit Districts.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                           ____________________________
                                                           Carlos Ramirez-Rosa
                                                           Alderman, 35th Ward




Common Address:
2411-23 North Kedzie Boulevard
